title: Sting vs. Flair: the young challenger becomes champion
summary: Sting’s breakout challenge to Ric Flair begins in JCP and continues into WCW. A brief Horsemen alliance ends when Sting refuses to surrender his title opportunity.

chapters.title: Sting lasts the distance with Flair
chapters.show: JCP Clash of the Champions I
chapters.result: Sting and Flair wrestle to a 45-minute draw for the NWA title.
chapters.context: The young challenger fails to win the belt but establishes himself as a serious threat to the champion.

chapters.title: The Horsemen expel Sting
chapters.result: The Horsemen turn against Sting over his title challenge.
chapters.context: Their alliance cannot survive Sting’s ambition to take Flair’s championship.

chapters.title: Sting wins his first world title
chapters.result: Sting defeats Flair for the NWA World Heavyweight championship.
chapters.context: Returning from injury, Sting finally converts the promise of the 1988 draw into a championship victory.
